title: Part (2 parts)
spec:
Create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero degrees and a translation vector also set to zero. In the first face, draw two circles: the first circle has a center at [0.0357, 0.0357] and a radius of 0.0357, while the second circle has the same center but a radius of 0.0315. Scale this sketch using a factor of 0.0714. Transform the scaled 2D sketch into 3D by applying no rotation or translation. Extrude the sketch 0.75 units along the normal direction to create a new solid body. The final dimensions of this cylindrical object are 0.07142857142857141 in length, 0.07142857142857141 in width, and 0.75 in height.

For the second part, create another coordinate system with Euler angles set to [0.0, 0.0, -90.0] degrees and a translation vector of [0.0268, 0.0357, 0.0268]. In the first face, draw a circle with a center at [0.0089, 0.0089] and a radius of 0.0089. In the second face, draw another circle with the same radius but centered at [0.0089, 0.6875]. Scale this sketch using a factor of 0.6964. Transform the scaled 2D sketch into 3D by rotating it -90 degrees around the Z-axis and translating it by [0.0268, 0.0357, 0.0268]. Extrude the sketch 0.0179 units along the normal direction and 0.0179 units in the opposite direction. Remove material from the existing body to create the protrusions. The final dimensions of this part are 0.017857142857142853 in length, 0.6964285714285713 in width, and 0.03571428571428571 in height.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Part 1
part_1 = cq.Workplane("XY").center(0.0357, 0.0357)
part_1 = part_1.circle(0.0357).circle(0.0315).extrude(0.75)

# Part 2
part_2 = cq.Workplane("XY").center(0.0089, 0.0089)
part_2 = part_2.circle(0.0089).extrude(0.0179, both=True)

# Translate and rotate part_2
part_2 = part_2.translate((0.0268, 0.0357, 0.0268)).rotate((0, 0, 0), (0, 0, 1), -90)

# Combine the parts
r = part_1.cut(part_2)

import cadquery as cq

# Define the initial coordinate system
workplane = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create the sketch for the base of the cylinder
sketch = (
    workplane
    .center(0.0357, 0.0357)  # Move to the center of the circle
    .circle(0.0357)  # Outer circle
    .circle(0.0316)  # Inner circle
)

# Extrude the sketch to create the cylinder
cylinder = sketch.extrude(0.75)

# Assign the final model to 'r'
r = cylinder
